fato_historico: 1945: The novella Animal Farm by George Orwell is first published.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a fresh chapter in your personal story, inviting you to challenge structures and seek authentic truth. Just as a powerful allegory might reveal hidden wisdom about leadership, consider how your own voice shapes the world around you. It is a good time to lead with integrity and let your unique, vibrant spirit shine brightly for all to see.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the courage to remain authentic to your noble heart.
significado_numero: A powerful number reflecting the manifestation of personal dreams and spiritual awakening.
conselho: Trust your intuition and stand firmly in your truth during every interaction today.
